subject: Great to meet at Inference Summit - next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Martinez <sofiam@cloudapps.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 10:23:00 -0700
Subject: Great to meet at Inference Summit - next steps

Hi Sofia,

Really great meeting you at the Inference Summit yesterday. I enjoyed our chat about how CloudApps is looking to speed up recommendation generation and reduce per-token costs in production. I promised to send a short overview and a couple of suggested next steps.

Quick recap:
- Current priority: lower inference latency for user-facing recs, and roll out a cheaper quantized model for lower-cost batch scoring.
- Concerns you mentioned: SOC 2 evidence, data residency, and predictable throughput for peak traffic.

Attachments: redwood-infer-brief.pdf (2-page product brief)

Suggested next steps:
1) 30-min discovery call with your infra/ML owner + our Solutions Engineer to map current flow and traffic patterns
2) Share a light Mutual Action Plan (MAP) so we can align stakeholders and timing
3) If helpful, I can share a short SOC 2 summary and our standard onboarding checklist

I have availability Tue/Wed next week (Oct 6/7) 9–11am PT or Thu Oct 8 1–3pm PT. If those don't work, tell me what does and I'll coordinate.

Thanks, would love to keep the momentum from the Summit.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0198
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 11:08:00 -0700

Hi Sofia,

Thanks, sending the SOC 2 summary and a short pricing snapshot attached. High-level answers below so you have something to share with Procurement quickly:

- SOC 2: Redwood maintains SOC 2 Type II; attached is a 1-page summary with our scope. We can discuss scoping options for POCs (e.g., limited data access, separate tenant).
- Data residency: hosted endpoints available in us-east-1; Dedicated/Private options for on-prem or VPC if required.
- Pricing (POC estimate): for a short POC using a standard open LLM on 2 GPUs, ballpark $X/day (~$Y/month) depending on sustained throughput and batching, happy to convert to a more detailed estimate once we have traffic profile.

Proposed MAP (short):
- Week 1: discovery call (infrastructure + ML owner)
- Week 2: config + baseline run (test dataset)
- Week 3: evaluate cost/latency, refine quantization profile
- Week 4: decision / options for Dedicated or hosted SLA

Availability: Tue Oct 6 9–11am PT, Wed Oct 7 10–12pm PT, or Fri Oct 9 1–3pm PT. If you prefer later, we can look at the following week.

Attachments: SOC2-summary.pdf, mutual-action-plan.xlsx

Would you like me to set up the discovery call and invite David (Solutions Eng) for the technical portion?

Best,
Marissa
